annotations.title: What would make this application stronger before it goes

description: What would make this application stronger before it goes. Before apply, or when the person asks "is this good enough?". Compares the advert with the tailored CV and the person's own CV (skills the advert asks for that the CV leaves out, years asked for, results without numbers), checks the cover letter (blanks, the company named, length, stock phrases, the strongest matches mentioned) and the employer's questions (unanswered or too short). Suggestions come most important first. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.
